statements.t: We expect to fund these requirements with cash on hand, cash generated from operations, and borrowings under our credit facility, if needed.

Our long-term cash requirements include approximately $534 thousand in lease obligations due beyond 12 months, along with anticipated capital expenditures to support our planned regional production facilities.
These commitments represent a significant use of cash and we expect to fund them through a combination of existing cash balances and cash flows from operations.
